title: 第四章师姐的滋味真不错
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
她的眉目突然紧锁，放下了手里的糕点，向外望去。

    可门外的场景依旧如平常般空旷，只有一两声脚步声传来。

    “嗒”“嗒”的脚步声有节奏般的传来，就像节拍器一般，一下又一下地打在了她的心口。

    这让她心里愈发不妙。

    不可能是那个炉鼎，一定是我想多了……

    就在她思索之时，一道身影突然出现在远处。

    她眯眼望去，顿时看清了那人的面容，当即神色剧变，立刻站起。

    怎么可能，他为什么还活着。

    他身后的那个，是狼妖的尸体……

    不可能，绝对不可能！

    他怎么可能杀死练气初期的妖兽，一定是我看错了。

    对，对……她心里不断安慰自己，但脑海中的不安已经出卖了她。

    她立刻几步向外走去，靠近那道身影。

    她要亲自看看，亲手肯定自己的想法。

    不过越走近，她的脚步也愈发变慢。

    怎么可能，怎么可能是他……她停在了原地，怔怔出神。

    他还活着，师姐给我的任务失败了。

    她顿时想到了师姐屋内那些刑具，当即打了个冷颤。

    不过她也不敢一下子暴露太多，只能徐徐图之。

    她脸上又挂起了那抹笑容，对着张守安说道：

    “师弟当真厉害，如此妖兽居然都不是师弟的对手。”

    张守安放下妖兽：“师姐谬赞，我只是运气好罢了。”

    郑雅微笑：“师弟真是谦虚。”

    她瞅了瞅张守安身上的伤口，一手抚上：“师弟伤得这般重，让师姐给你擦擦药可好？顺便晚上……”

    她眼神含波，看起来楚楚可怜，让人产生不了一句拒绝的话语。

    她手指慢慢游走，动作极其轻柔。

    这是她最后的机会了，她要在今晚将张守安留下，再伺机杀掉，以绝后患。

    不然，今晚江燕一回来就真的来不及了。

    张守安眉目微皱。

    其实他也想答应，有这样一个美人突然来献殷勤，谁能拒绝。

    不过，这可是魔宗，自己现在只要答应，晚上估计连渣都没了。
content_en:
Her brows suddenly furrowed, she put down the cake in her hand and looked outside.

But the scene outside the door was still as empty as usual, with only one or two footsteps coming.

The footsteps of "ta" and "ta" came rhythmically, like a metronome, hitting her heart again and again.

This made her feel even worse.

It can't be that furnace, I must be overthinking...

While she was thinking, a figure suddenly appeared in the distance.

She squinted her eyes and saw the man's face clearly. Her expression changed drastically and she stood up immediately.

How is it possible, why is he still alive.

The one behind him is the corpse of the wolf demon...

Impossible, absolutely impossible!

How could he kill the monster in the early stage of Qi training? I must have seen it wrong.

Yes, yes... She kept comforting herself in her heart, but the uneasiness in her mind had betrayed her.

She immediately took a few steps outside and approached the figure.

She wanted to see it for herself and confirm her thoughts with her own hands.

But the closer she got, the slower her pace became.

How could it be possible, how could it be him... She stopped where she was, stunned.

He is still alive, and the mission given to me by my senior sister failed.

She immediately thought of the instruments of torture in her senior sister's house, and immediately shuddered.

However, she didn't dare to expose too much at once, so she could only figure it out slowly.

She put that smile on her face again and said to Zhang Shou'an:

"Junior brother is really powerful. Such monsters are no match for junior brother."

Zhang Shou'an put down the monster and said, "Sister, I'm just lucky."

Zheng Ya smiled: "Junior brother is so humble."

She looked at Zhang Shou'an's wounds and touched them with one hand: "Junior brother is so seriously injured, can you ask me to give you some medicine? By the way, tonight..."

Her eyes were full of emotion and she looked pitiful, making it impossible for anyone to say a word of rejection.

Her fingers slowly moved around, her movements extremely gentle.

This is her last chance. She will keep Zhang Shou'an tonight and wait for an opportunity to kill him to avoid future troubles.

Otherwise, it will really be too late when Jiang Yan comes back tonight.

Zhang Shouan frowned slightly.

In fact, he also wanted to agree. With such a beauty suddenly coming to show her courtesy, who could refuse.

However, this is the Demon Sect. As long as he agrees now, he will probably be gone by the evening.
